folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B317: literal-self promises and later bounded follow-through
folds.body:
All363 original lines were content-reviewed, including F1–F8, I1–I3, M1–M7 and their consequences, K1–K5, E1–E5, B1–B5/V1–V9, H1–H5, U1–U4, S1–S4/Q1–Q5, N1–N5/TP1–TP12, three public original candidates, the completed parallel audit and verification history. The later four-worker delivery supersedes the earlier future-audit wording for its sixteen bounded windows across four supplied works. Nine overlapping windows/110 paragraph elements are that receipt's independent source-check scope, not four whole books newly read here. The permanent author and playable worlds remain proposals; linked reports and source windows are not reviewed by proxy.

The central distinction is subject continuity versus retained information/capacity/property. Reliable memory does not itself prove transfer rather than copying, and changed anatomy does not by itself prove a different subject. The original fiction can declare either without solving a universal ontology. A live outside channel differs from an entry-memory snapshot; intention, a modern label, a transmitted diagram, contextual host knowledge and a mastery grant provide different means. Strong accurate channels or immediate competence can work fully where granted. No blanket uncertainty tax, apprenticeship, synchronization penalty, mandatory trauma or possession struggle follows from these records.

Literal-self is a fictional premise and a supported player-supplied input contract, not a claim of consciousness transfer or permission to infer the user's biography, qualifications, private acquaintances or beliefs. Ordinary save/settings/accessibility and supported routine summaries retain their usability without becoming diegetic powers. A menu's presence grants no fictional channel or real filesystem reach. Conversely, a specifically admitted interface power can have real in-world effects without putting the actual computer or personal saves at risk in the fiction. No actual file access, save deletion or outside information event is authorized by a story claim.

Existing-body entry needs actual occupant/control, memory access, bodily/soul faculty, social evidence and custody answers for the selected operation. An original already-departed wrong-soul rite is one clear proposal, not a fact about every book opening. Known practical terms can be legible while an ultimate cause remains sealed. A remembered relationship, a copied account, a separate person's bond and a declared continuous fusion differ; accurate memory can inform a new promise without retroactively making it fulfilled. Actual powerful multi-body continuity may keep simultaneous commitments, while sharing their recollection alone does not perform them. Genuine reliable recognition need not be delayed by an invented suspicion quest.

Different body age, experienced time, home calendar and world clock require their actual admitted rate and carrier. The twelve-years/one-afternoon example is hypothetical, not a hidden offline-advancement feature. A summary may compress chosen routine under current AD52 while preserving material decisions, means, costs and retained consequences. It cannot silently invent expenditures or major promises. Paused and destroyed worlds, counterparts, reachable home, final closure and a voluntary stop remain separate outcomes. A supported continuing self may stay indefinitely without forced death or compulsory reincarnation.

The old first-realm/first-prestige boundary is retired. The five Q fields are scoped authoring decisions rather than a fresh universal questionnaire for Weibao; current direction permits reasonable defaults and per-world variants. Ask only for a material unresolved choice in a selected consequential operation. Human acceptance of tone remains available, while AD42 makes generic review optional rather than a blanket implementation blocker. The E1/E2/E4 comparison is a useful optional experiment, not a prerequisite before a first shared consumer under AD51.

N/TP preserve straight power fantasy, quiet ordinary life and alternate causal responses alongside subversion. A source beat, source-qualified AU and original composition need explicit provenance and compatible world laws. Changing only names does not settle a different experience; a fixed dramatic plan must yield to actual removed causes or supported player choices. The later narrative-author workflow establishes a bounded proposed role and recoverable artifacts, not a permanent worker, required multi-agent organization, universal lore registry or runtime story generator. No source acquisition, private reading, new worker, literal-self profile, implemented start, accepted ontology or priority change was created by this review.
